Department: Department of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution Enforcement Date: 15-04-1987 Type: CENTRAL ACT (Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Department of Consumer Affairs) Location: Manipur Notification: 15th April, 1987, vide notification No. S.O. 390(E), dated 15th April, 1987 in respect of Chapters I, II and IV, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II,
